relationships.object: cortical thickness in anterior cingulate cortex
relationships.evidence_quote: Decreased cortical thickness within the whole group was detected mainly in the bilateral orbitofrontal and right anterior cingulate areas after 3 months of treatment with galcanezumab

key_findings: Three months of galcanezumab decreased cortical thickness in ACC, somatosensory, prefrontal and supramarginal regions of responders.
Thinning is interpreted as recovery from hyperexcitability after reduced nociceptive input.
